title: Behavioral slicing and affinity matrix for KV-cache version anchoring
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Define and implement a behavioral-slicing approach and affinity matrix that maps sequence distribution slices to best-fit KV cache versions for each model, then publish per-model performance profiles and automated anchoring recommendations. Deliverables: 1) definition of behavioral slices (token entropy, repetition score, prefix density, session length buckets, system prompt vs user content split); 2) affinity matrix computation and storage format; 3) onboarding pipeline changes to compute slice-weighted benchmarks for new model versions; 4) profile publish workflow and advisory for version anchoring; 5) guardrails for roll-forward/rollback when affinity signals are weak. Success metrics: reduce cold-miss tail latency (95/99) by >=15% for long-context workloads that match heavy-tail slices; limit incorrect anchor assignments to <3% in canaries; surface clear key-value (slice x version) confidence scores in Console. Approach: sample production traces by session and compute per-sequence slice labels; run comparators across model versions under representative KV configurations (retention, prefetch settings) and record per-slice token throughput, 95/99 latency, KV hit rates, and quality regression deltas on a small eval set. Build an affinity scoring heuristic that combines (normalized latency improvement, hit-rate lift, and quality regression penalty) with configurable weights. Expose API that returns ranked version anchors with confidence and recommend pin/soft-pin/rollover strategies. Implementation notes: produce a compact CSV/NDJSON artifact per model-version containing slice metrics and a derived "affinity_score" for each slice; integration point is the existing onboarding pipeline (onboard-worker-v2).
comments: 2025-02-18 - Triage: Identified recurring failures in onboarding where long-seq variants mis-pinned leading to tail latency spikes. Assigned to Tomás. Priority set to P1 due to customer impact on dedicated capacity tenants.

2025-02-20 - Design sync: Agreed on initial set of behavioral slices: short(0-512), mid(513-2048), long(2049-8192), ultra-long(>8192); repetition-ratio bins; prefix-entropy quartiles. Decided to include system-prompt split as a binary slice flag. Proposal documented: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/KV+Affinity+Design (internal).

2025-02-25 - Sampling job prototype: Created sampling job that emits per-session serialized sequence metadata and small reference token stream (no PII). Sample set: 2M sequences across hosted + dedicated (last 30 days). Link to dataset snapshot: s3://redwood-internal/kv-affinity/snapshots/2025-02-25. Note: dataset excludes flagged customers per privacy policy.

2025-02-28 - Benchmark run 1: Compared runtime-1.20 vs runtime-1.22 candidate under same KV retention policy. Observed 18% 95th reduction in "long" slice but a 2.4% drop in a targeted eval for code-generation prompts. Discussed weight tuning for quality penalty in affinity score.

2025-03-01 - Implementation: Added affinity scoring stage to onboarding pipeline (branch: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pulls/4123). The scoring stage emits per-slice metrics and a normalized score. Initial scoring weights: latency:0.6, hit_rate:0.3, quality_penalty: -0.5. Will iterate weights after canary results.

2025-03-03 - Canary plan: Create canary run on dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu-3' with soft-pin policy (traffic split 95% current, 5% candidate) for customers matching >60% of their traffic in 'long' slice. Canary duration 72h with automated rollback if 95/99 latency or quality degrade beyond thresholds. Canary orchestration ticket: ENG-182360 (depends).

2025-03-04 - Dashboard & publish format: Console dashboard tile spec drafted to show slice-level affinity scores and recommended action (pin/soft-pin/hold). Publishing format decided: NDJSON lines with fields: model, version, slice_id, affinity_score, delta_latency_p95, delta_hit_rate, quality_regression_pct, sample_weight. Publish endpoint: internal onboarding-publish/v1. Artifact example: s3://redwood-internal/kv-affinity/published/2025-03-04/.

2025-03-05 - Blockers/risks: Need cryptographic review for including small reference token streams in artifacts (privacy). Security requested redaction policy. Also require small compute budget increase for nightly sampling runs; added as dependency to infra budget request PR.

Next steps: 1) Run weighted-parameter sweep (latency/hit/quality weights) and produce ROC-like curves for mispin vs tail-latency gain. 2) Run two 72h canaries, collect telemetry, and refine production thresholds. 3) Add automatic "confidence decay" for anchors older than 30 days and schedule re-eval.
